posteriores.texto: Ainda durante o dia, todo o povo veio insistir para que Davi comesse. Mas Davi jurou: “Que Deus me castigue, e ainda mais, se eu provar pão ou qualquer outra coisa antes do pôr do sol!”
Todo o povo percebeu isso e aprovou, pois tudo o que o rei fazia parecia bom aos olhos de todo o povo.

kjv.texto: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

vizinhos.33: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
vizinhos.35: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
